title: Outbuilding rebuilt after fire on a partly re-used slab: code compliance certificate refused (historical work)

facts.text: A detached one-and-a-half-storey building on a large flat rural site, with a footprint of about 68 m2 and an attic of about 40 m2.
The outbuilding was built after a fire destroyed an existing garage; the new reinforced concrete slab was poured partly over the existing slab and foundations.

Construction is light timber frame with engineered exposed timber roof trusses, timber-framed attic floors, rusticated timber weatherboards, plywood wall cladding that also provides structural bracing, and aluminium joinery.
Figure 2 shows the original outbuilding (p.3); Figure 3 shows the current building (p.4).
